description: Performs one action (click, key, drag or wait) in a session started by gamealia_playtest; actions of one session run one at a time, in order. Returns the new screenshot, the step number and steps left, the SDK calls since the last step, new console errors, ad requests and how much the frame changed (0% often means the input did nothing). Fails if the session ended or expired; when steps run out, call gamealia_playtest_stop.

action.description: One action: {type:"click",x,y} | {type:"key",key,holdMs?} | {type:"drag",from:{x,y},to:{x,y}} | {type:"wait",ms}; coordinates in viewport pixels

oneOf.description: Click (a tap on the mobile profile)

key.description: Playwright key name: ArrowLeft, Space, Enter, KeyW, a, ...

name: gamealia_playtest_act
title: Playtest action
